in_hebrew.name: Arratoon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Arratoon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'arrhe' (rest, repose) and 'aton' (unattainable). Arratoon symbolizes a strong, unattainable mountain of faith and resilience.

in_greek.name: Arratoon

in_greek.long_meaning: Arratoon είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'arrhe' (rest, repose) and 'aton' (unattainable). Arratoon symbolizes a strong, unattainable mountain of faith and resilience.

in_latin.name: Arratoon
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong mountain
